43// NOTE: (YiLiangSiew) Currently, Visual Verse relies on the numerical values of these enumerations. If you
44// change this, be sure to update `BaseVisualVerseSettings.ini` as well.
45#define VERSE_VISIT_AST_NODE_TYPES(v) \
46 /* Helper expressions */ \
47 v(Error_, CExprError) /* An expression that could not be analyzed due to an error. Attempts to analyze should propagate the error. */ \
48 v(Placeholder_, CExprPlaceholder) /* Corresponds to a Placeholder Vst node. */ \
49 v(Noop_, CNoop) /* Nice to have when something should be ignored. */ \
50 v(External, CExprExternal) /* An (unknown) external expression - should never reach the code generator */ \
51 v(PathPlusSymbol, CExprPathPlusSymbol) /* Path of the current scope plus a symbol - /unrealengine.com/UnrealEngine@5 */ \
52 \
53 /* Literals */ \
54 v(Literal_Logic, CExprLogic) /* Logic literal - true/false */ \
55 v(Literal_Number, CExprNumber) /* Integer literal - 42, 0, -123, 123_456_789, 0x12fe, 0b101010 */ \
56 /* or Float literal - 42.0, 0.0, -123.0, 123_456.0, 3.14159, .5, -.33, 4.2e1, -1e6, 7.5e-8 */ \
57 v(Literal_Char, CExprChar) /* Character literal - 'a', '\n' */ \
58 v(Literal_String, CExprString) /* String literal - "Hello, world!", "Line 1\nLine2" */ \
59 v(Literal_Path, CExprPath) /* Path literal - /unrealengine.com/UnrealEngine@5 */ \
60 v(Literal_Enum, CExprEnumLiteral) /* Enumerator - Color.Red, Size.XXL */ \
61 v(Literal_Type, CExprType) /* Type - type{<expr>} */ \
62 v(Literal_Function, CExprFunctionLiteral) /* a=>b or function(a){b} */ \
63 \
64 /* Identifiers */ \
65 v(Identifier_Unresolved, CExprIdentifierUnresolved) /* An existing identifier that is unresolved. It is produced by desugaring and consumed by analysis. */ \
66 v(Identifier_Class, CExprIdentifierClass) /* Type identifier - e.g. my_type, int, color, string */ \
67 v(Identifier_Module, CExprIdentifierModule) /* Module name */ \
68 v(Identifier_ModuleAlias, CExprIdentifierModuleAlias) /* Module alias name */ \
69 v(Identifier_Enum, CExprEnumerationType) /* Enum name */ \
70 v(Identifier_Interface, CExprInterfaceType) /* Interface name */ \
71 v(Identifier_Data, CExprIdentifierData) /* Scoped data-definition (class member, local, etc.) */ \
72 v(Identifier_TypeAlias, CExprIdentifierTypeAlias) /* Access to type alias */ \
73 v(Identifier_TypeVariable, CExprIdentifierTypeVariable) /* Access to a type variable */ \
74 v(Identifier_Function, CExprIdentifierFunction) /* Access to functions */ \
75 v(Identifier_OverloadedFunction, CExprIdentifierOverloadedFunction) /* An overloaded function identifier that hasn't been resolved to a specific overload. */ \
76 v(Identifier_Self, CExprSelf) /* Access to the instance the current function is being invoked on. */ \
77 v(Identifier_Local, CExprLocal) /* Access to the the current scope for the identifier that has this qualifier. */ \
78 v(Identifier_BuiltInMacro, CExprIdentifierBuiltInMacro) /* An intrinsic macro: option{}, logic{}, array{}, etc. */ \
79 \
80 /* Multi purpose syntax */ \
81 v(Definition, CExprDefinition) /* represents syntactic forms elt:domain=value, elt:domain, elt=value */ \
82 \
83 /* Macro */ \
84 v(MacroCall, CExprMacroCall) /* macro invocations should be resolved by the compiler; the code generator should never encounter this. */ \
85 \
86 /* Invocations */ \
87 v(Invoke_Invocation, CExprInvocation) /* Routine call - expr1.call(expr2, expr3) */ \
88 v(Invoke_UnaryArithmetic, CExprUnaryArithmetic) /* negation */ \
89 v(Invoke_BinaryArithmetic, CExprBinaryArithmetic) /* add, sub, mul, div; two operands only */ \
90 v(Invoke_ShortCircuitAnd, CExprShortCircuitAnd) /* short-circuit evaluation of logic and */ \
91 v(Invoke_ShortCircuitOr, CExprShortCircuitOr) /* short-circuit evaluation of logic or */ \
92 v(Invoke_LogicalNot, CExprLogicalNot) /* logical not operator */ \
93 v(Invoke_Comparison, CExprComparison) /* comparison operators */ \
94 v(Invoke_QueryValue, CExprQueryValue) /* Querying the value of a logic or option. */ \
95 v(Invoke_MakeOption, CExprMakeOption) /* Making an option value. */ \
96 v(Invoke_MakeArray, CExprMakeArray) /* Making an array value. */ \
97 v(Invoke_MakeMap, CExprMakeMap) /* Making a map value. */ \
98 v(Invoke_MakeTuple, CExprMakeTuple) /* Making a tuple value - (1, 2.0f, "three") */ \
99 v(Invoke_TupleElement, CExprTupleElement) /* Tuple element access `TupleExpr(Idx)` */ \
100 v(Invoke_MakeRange, CExprMakeRange) /* Making a range value. */ \
101 v(Invoke_Type, CExprInvokeType) /* Invoke a type as a function on a value - type(expr) or type[expr]. */ \
102 v(Invoke_PointerToReference, CExprPointerToReference) /* Access the mutable reference behind the pointer. */ \
103 v(Invoke_Set, CExprSet) /* Evaluate operand to an l-expression. */ \
104 v(Invoke_NewPointer, CExprNewPointer) /* Create a new pointer from an initial value. */ \
105 v(Invoke_ReferenceToValue, CExprReferenceToValue) /* Evaluates the value of an expression yielding a reference type. */ \
106 \
107 v(Assignment, CExprAssignment) /* Assignment operation - expr1 = expr2, expr1 := expr2, expr1 += expr2, etc. */ \
108 \
109 /* TypeFormers */ \
110 v(Invoke_ArrayFormer, CExprArrayTypeFormer) /* Invoke (at compile time) a formation of an array of another type */ \
111 v(Invoke_GeneratorFormer, CExprGeneratorTypeFormer) /* Invoke (at compile time) a formation of an generator type. */ \
112 v(Invoke_MapFormer, CExprMapTypeFormer) /* Invoke (at compile time) a formation of a map from a key and value type. */ \
113 v(Invoke_OptionFormer, CExprOptionTypeFormer) /* Invoke (at compile time) a formation of an option of some primitive type */ \
114 v(Invoke_Subtype, CExprSubtype) /* Invoke (at compile time) a formation of a metaclass type. */ \
115 v(Invoke_TupleType, CExprTupleType) /* Get or create a tuple based on `tuple(type1, type2, ...)` */ \
116 v(Invoke_Arrow, CExprArrow) /* Create a function type from a parameter and return type. */ \
117 \
118 v(Invoke_ArchetypeInstantiation, CExprArchetypeInstantiation) /* Initializer list style instantiation - Type{expr1, id=expr2, ...} */ \
119 \
120 /* Flow Control */ \
121 v(Flow_CodeBlock, CExprCodeBlock) /* Code block - block {expr1; expr2} */ \
122 v(Flow_Let, CExprLet) /* let {definition1; definition2} */ \
123 v(Flow_Defer, CExprDefer) /* defer {expr1; expr2} */ \
124 v(Flow_If, CExprIf) /* Conditional with failable tests- if (Test[]) {clause1}, if (Test[]) {clause1} else {else_clause} */ \
125 v(Flow_Iteration, CExprIteration) /* Bounded iteration over an iterable type - for(Num:Nums, ...) {DoStuff(Num, ...)} */ \
126 v(Flow_First, CExprFirst) /* Find first over an iterable type - first(Num:Nums, ...) {DoStuff(Num, ...)} */ \
127 v(Flow_Loop, CExprLoop) /* Simple loop - loop {DoStuff()} */ \
128 v(Flow_Break, CExprBreak) /* Control flow early exit - loop {if (IsEarlyExit[]) {break}; DoLoopStuff()} */ \
129 v(Flow_Return, CExprReturn) /* Return statement - return expr */ \
130 v(Flow_ProfileBlock, CExprProfileBlock) /* profile block */\
131 \
132 v(Ir_AllOne, CIrAllOne) /* Bounded iteration over an iterable type - either for(Num:Nums) {DoStuff(Num)} or first (Num:Nums) {DoStuff(Num)} */ \
133 v(Ir_For, CIrFor) /* Bounded iteration over an iterable type - for(Num:Nums) {DoStuff(Num)} */ \
134 v(Ir_IteratedBody, CIrIteratedBody) /* Used inside CIrFor when implementing for and first, and only around the body of the innermost CIrFor */ \
135 v(Ir_ArrayAdd, CIrArrayAdd) /* Append an item to an array */ \
136 v(Ir_MapAdd, CIrMapAdd) /* Add a key-value pair to a map */ \
137 v(Ir_ArrayUnsafeCall, CIrArrayUnsafeCall) /* Infallibly access an element of an array */ \
138 v(Ir_ConvertToDynamic, CIrConvertToDynamic) /* Converts a value to a dynamically typed value. */ \
139 v(Ir_ConvertFromDynamic, CIrConvertFromDynamic) /* Converts a value from a dynamically typed value. */ \
140 v(Ir_DataOfDynamic, CIrDataOfDynamic) /* Access data pointer of dynamically typed value. */ \
141 \
142 /* Concurrency Primitives */ \
143 v(Concurrent_Sync, CExprSync) /* sync {Coro1(); Coro2()} */ \
144 v(Concurrent_Rush, CExprRush) /* rush {Coro1(); Coro2()} */ \
145 v(Concurrent_Race, CExprRace) /* race {Coro1(); Coro2()} */ \
146 v(Concurrent_SyncIterated, CExprSyncIterated) /* sync(Item:Container) {Item.Coro1(); Coro2(Item)} */ \
147 v(Concurrent_RushIterated, CExprRushIterated) /* rush(Item:Container) {Item.Coro1(); Coro2(Item)} */ \
148 v(Concurrent_RaceIterated, CExprRaceIterated) /* race(Item:Container) {Item.Coro1(); Coro2(Item)} */ \
149 v(Concurrent_Branch, CExprBranch) /* branch {Coro1(); Coro2()} */ \
150 v(Concurrent_Spawn, CExprSpawn) /* spawn {Coro()} */ \
151 v(Concurrent_Await, CExprAwait) /* await {E} */ \
152 v(Concurrent_Batch, CExprBatch) /* batch {E} */ \
153 v(Concurrent_Upon, CExprUpon) /* upon(E1) {E2} */ \
154 v(Concurrent_When, CExprWhen) /* when(E1) {E2} */ \
155 \
156 /* Definitions */ \
157 v(Definition_Module, CExprModuleDefinition) \
158 v(Definition_Enum, CExprEnumDefinition) \
159 v(Definition_Interface, CExprInterfaceDefinition) \
160 v(Definition_Class, CExprClassDefinition) \
161 v(Definition_Data, CExprDataDefinition) \
162 v(Definition_IterationPair, CExprIterationPairDefinition) \
163 v(Definition_Function, CExprFunctionDefinition) \
164 v(Definition_TypeAlias, CExprTypeAliasDefinition) \
165 v(Definition_Using, CExprUsing) \
166 v(Definition_Import, CExprImport) \
167 v(Definition_Where, CExprWhere) \
168 v(Definition_Var, CExprVar) \
169 v(Definition_Live, CExprLive) \
170 v(Definition_ScopedAccessLevel, CExprScopedAccessLevelDefinition) \
171 v(Invoke_MakeNamed, CExprMakeNamed) /* ?ParamName:=Value pair - or default value placeholder (value not set) */ \
172 \
173 /* Containing Context - may contain expressions though they aren't expressions themselves */ \

204//---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
205// Indicates whether an expression should return immediately - such as functions, after a
206// duration (including immediately) such as coroutines or either.
207enum class EInvokeTime : uint8_t
208{
209 Immediate = 1 << 0, // May only call an immediate expression (such as a function call) and any async expression (such as a coroutine call) should result in an error.
210 Async = 1 << 1, // May only call an async expression (such as a coroutine call) and any immediate expression (such as a function call) should result in an error. Only true within one of the pre-defined calling contexts (`sync{}`, `race{}`, etc.).
211 Any_ = Immediate | Async // Calling either immediate or async expressions is allowed.
212};
213
214inline const char* InvokeTimeAsCString(EInvokeTime InvokeTime)
215{
216 switch(InvokeTime)
217 {
218 case EInvokeTime::Immediate: return "Immediate";
219 case EInvokeTime::Async: return "Async";
220 case EInvokeTime::Any_: return "Any_";
221 default: ULANG_UNREACHABLE();
222 }
223}

229struct SAstVisitor
230{
232 virtual void VisitImmediate(const char* FieldName, CUTF8StringView Value) {}
233 virtual void VisitImmediate(const char* FieldName, int64_t Value) {}
234 virtual void VisitImmediate(const char* FieldName, double Value) {}
235 virtual void VisitImmediate(const char* FieldName, bool Value) {}
236 virtual void VisitImmediate(const char* FieldName, const CTypeBase* Type) {}
237 virtual void VisitImmediate(const char* FieldName, const CDefinition& Definition) {}
238 virtual void VisitImmediate(const char* FieldName, const Verse::Vst::Node& VstNode) {}
239
240 void VisitImmediate(const char* FieldName, const char* CString) { VisitImmediate(FieldName, CUTF8StringView(CString)); }
241
242 virtual void Visit(const char* FieldName, CAstNode& AstNode) = 0;
243 virtual void BeginArray(const char* FieldName, intptr_t Num) {}
244 virtual void VisitElement(CAstNode& AstNode) = 0;
245 virtual void EndArray() {}
246
247 template<typename NodeType, bool bAllowNull, typename AllocatorType, typename... AllocatorArgTypes>
248 void Visit(const char* FieldName, const TSPtrG<NodeType, bAllowNull, AllocatorType, AllocatorArgTypes...>& NodePointer)
249 {
250 if (!bAllowNull || NodePointer.IsValid())
251 {
252 Visit(FieldName, *NodePointer);
253 }
254 }
255
256 template<typename NodeType, bool bAllowNull, typename AllocatorType, typename... AllocatorArgTypes>
257 void VisitElement(const TSPtrG<NodeType, bAllowNull, AllocatorType, AllocatorArgTypes...>& NodePointer)
258 {
259 if (!bAllowNull || NodePointer.IsValid())
260 {
261 VisitElement(*NodePointer);
262 }
263 }
264
265 template<typename NodeType, bool bAllowNull, typename NodeAllocatorType, typename ElementAllocatorType, typename... ElementAllocatorArgTypes>
266 void VisitArray(const char* FieldName, const TArrayG<TSPtrG<NodeType, bAllowNull, NodeAllocatorType>, ElementAllocatorType, ElementAllocatorArgTypes...>& Array)
267 {
268 BeginArray(FieldName, Array.Num());
269 for (const TSPtrG<NodeType, bAllowNull, NodeAllocatorType>& Element : Array)
270 {
271 if (!bAllowNull || Element.IsValid())
272 {
273 VisitElement(*Element);
274 }
275 }
276 EndArray();
277 }
278
279 template<typename NodeType, bool bAllowNull, typename ElementAllocatorType, typename... RawAllocatorArgTypes>
280 void VisitArray(const char* FieldName, const TSPtrArrayG<NodeType, bAllowNull, ElementAllocatorType, RawAllocatorArgTypes...>& Array)
281 {
282 BeginArray(FieldName, Array.Num());
283 for (NodeType* Node : Array)
284 {
285 if (!bAllowNull || Node)
286 {
287 VisitElement(*Node);
288 }
289 }
290 EndArray();
291 }
292};

302class AUTORTFM_DISABLE CAstNode : public CSharedMix
303{
304public:
305 CAstNode(EVstMappingType VstMappingType = EVstMappingType::Ast) : _VstMappingType(VstMappingType) {}
306
307 UE_API virtual ~CAstNode();
308
309 virtual EAstNodeType GetNodeType() const = 0;
310 virtual const CExpressionBase* AsExpression() const { return nullptr; }
311 virtual CExpressionBase* AsExpression() { return nullptr; }
312 virtual bool MayHaveAttributes() const { return true; }
313 virtual const CExprIdentifierBase* AsIdentifierBase() const { return nullptr; }
314
318 virtual void VisitImmediates(SAstVisitor& Visitor) const
319 {
320 const char* VstMappingTypeString;
321 switch(_VstMappingType)
322 {
323 case EVstMappingType::Ast: VstMappingTypeString = "Ast"; break;
324 case EVstMappingType::AstNonReciprocal: VstMappingTypeString = "AstNonReciprocal"; break;
325 case EVstMappingType::Ir: VstMappingTypeString = "Ir"; break;
326 default: ULANG_UNREACHABLE();
327 };
328 Visitor.VisitImmediate("VstMappingType", VstMappingTypeString);
329 if (_MappedVstNode)
330 {
331 Visitor.VisitImmediate("MappedVstNode", *_MappedVstNode);
332 }
333 }
334
338 virtual void VisitChildren(SAstVisitor& Visitor) const {}
339
345 template<typename FunctionType>
346 void VisitChildrenLambda(FunctionType&& Function) const;
347
348 //~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
349 // Text methods
350 virtual CUTF8String GetErrorDesc() const = 0;
351
352 //~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
353 // Syntax <> Semantic Mapping
354 const Verse::Vst::Node* GetMappedVstNode() const { return _MappedVstNode; }
355
356 void SetNonReciprocalMappedVstNode(const Verse::Vst::Node* VstNode)
357 {
358 _VstMappingType = EVstMappingType::AstNonReciprocal;
359 _MappedVstNode = VstNode;
360 }
361
362 void SetIrMappedVstNode(const Verse::Vst::Node* VstNode)
363 {
364 _VstMappingType = EVstMappingType::Ir;
365 _MappedVstNode = VstNode;
366 }
367
368 // True if this AstNode is used to represent an IrNode. Needed to disable some asserts and clean up code.
369 // Will be removed when IrNodes have their own type.
370 bool IsIrNode() const
371 {
372 return _VstMappingType == EVstMappingType::Ir;
373 }
374
375 bool IsVstMappingReciprocal() const
376 {
377 return _VstMappingType == EVstMappingType::Ast;
378 }
379
380protected:
381
382 friend struct Verse::Vst::Node;
383 // Syntax<>Semantic mapping
384 mutable EVstMappingType _VstMappingType;
385 mutable const Verse::Vst::Node* _MappedVstNode{nullptr};
386};

392class AUTORTFM_DISABLE CExpressionBase : public CAstNode, public CAttributable
393{
394public:
395
396 explicit CExpressionBase(EVstMappingType VstMappingType = EVstMappingType::Ast) : CAstNode(VstMappingType) {}
397 explicit CExpressionBase(const CTypeBase* InResultType)
398 : _Report(SAnalysisResult{InResultType})
399 {}
400
401 virtual const CExpressionBase* AsExpression() const override { return this; }
402 virtual CExpressionBase* AsExpression() override { return this; }
403 virtual bool MayHaveAttributes() const override { return false; }
404
405 using TMacroSymbols = TArrayG<CSymbol, TInlineElementAllocator<3>>;
406 // True if this expression can be path of a segment. It works at all times, i.e., also before macro expression have been processed.
407 // The MacroSymbols argument is used in the latter case.
408 virtual bool CanBePathSegment(const TMacroSymbols& MacroSymbols) const { return false; }
409 virtual void VisitImmediates(SAstVisitor& Visitor) const override
410 {
411 CAstNode::VisitImmediates(Visitor);
412 if (_Report.IsSet())
413 {
414 Visitor.VisitImmediate("ResultType", _Report->ResultType);
415 }
416 }
417
418 // Determines if expression is immediate (completes within the current update/frame) or
419 // async (completes within the current update/frame or later).
420 //
421 // @TODO: SOL-1423, DetermineInvokeTime() re-traverses the expression tree, which could add up time wise
422 // (approaching on n^2) -- there should be a beter way to check this on the initial ProcessExpression()
423 EInvokeTime DetermineInvokeTime(const CSemanticProgram& Program) const { return (FindFirstAsyncSubExpr(Program) == nullptr) ? EInvokeTime::Immediate : EInvokeTime::Async; }
424
425 // Returns itself or the first async sub-expression or return nullptr if it and all its sub-expressions are immediate.
426 virtual const CExpressionBase* FindFirstAsyncSubExpr(const CSemanticProgram& Program) const { return nullptr; }
427
428 // Returns whether the expression may fail.
429 virtual bool CanFail(const CAstPackage* Package) const { return false; }
430
431 //~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
432 // Type methods
433 UE_API virtual const CTypeBase* GetResultType(const CSemanticProgram& Program) const;
434 UE_API void SetResultType(const CTypeBase* InResultType);
435 UE_API void RefineResultType(const CTypeBase* RefinedResultType);
436
437 bool IsAnalyzed() const { return _Report.IsSet(); }
438
439 const CTypeBase* IrGetResultType() const { return _Report ? _Report->ResultType : nullptr; }
440 void IrSetResultType(const CTypeBase* TypeBase)
441 {
442 if (TypeBase)
443 {
444 _Report = SAnalysisResult{ TypeBase };
445 }
446 else
447 {
448 _Report.Reset();
449 }
450 }
451
452 // We begin by collecting each node's individual effects during SemanticAnalysis.
453 // During AST IR generation, we do a pass to sum up the aggregate effects representing
454 // each node and the code reachable within it.
455 // These effects are conservative. We may say a node has some effects that it doesn't actually
456 // have. For example, we'll propagate the <decides> effect outside of a failure context, even
457 // though the failure context will eat the <decides> effect. It will be easy to make this mor precise
458 // if we ever need it to be.
459 SEffectSet Effects;
460
461protected:
462
463
464 // Analysis Results
465 struct SAnalysisResult
466 {
467 bool operator==(const SAnalysisResult& Other) const { return ResultType == Other.ResultType; }
469 const CTypeBase* ResultType;
470 };
471
472 TOptional<SAnalysisResult> _Report;
473
474}; // CExpressionBase

481class AUTORTFM_DISABLE CExprCompoundBase : public CExpressionBase
482{
483public:
484 // Methods
485
486 explicit CExprCompoundBase(int32_t ReserveSubExprNum, EVstMappingType VstMappingType = EVstMappingType::Ast)
487 : CExpressionBase(VstMappingType)
488 {
489 _SubExprs.Reserve(ReserveSubExprNum);
490 }
491
492 explicit CExprCompoundBase(TArray<TSRef<CExpressionBase>>&& SubExprs, EVstMappingType VstMappingType = EVstMappingType::Ast)
493 : CExpressionBase(VstMappingType)
494 , _SubExprs(Move(SubExprs))
495 {}
496
497 explicit CExprCompoundBase(TSRef<CExpressionBase>&& SubExpr1, TSRef<CExpressionBase>&& SubExpr2)
498 : CExprCompoundBase(2)
499 {
500 AppendSubExpr(Move(SubExpr1));
501 AppendSubExpr(Move(SubExpr2));
502 }
503
504 CExprCompoundBase() = default;
505
506 bool IsEmpty() const { return _SubExprs.IsEmpty(); }
507 int32_t SubExprNum() const { return _SubExprs.Num(); }
508 const uLang::CExpressionBase* GetLastSubExpr() const { return _SubExprs.Last(); }
509 const TArray<TSRef<CExpressionBase>>& GetSubExprs() const { return _SubExprs; }
510 TArray<TSRef<CExpressionBase>>& GetSubExprs() { return _SubExprs; }
511 TArray<TSRef<CExpressionBase>>&& TakeSubExprs() { return Move(_SubExprs); }
512 void AppendSubExpr(TSRef<CExpressionBase> SubExpr) { _SubExprs.Add(Move(SubExpr)); }
513 void PrependSubExpr(TSRef<CExpressionBase> SubExpr) { _SubExprs.Insert(Move(SubExpr), 0); }
514 void SetSubExprs(TArray<TSRef<CExpressionBase>>&& AnalyzedExprs) { _SubExprs = Move(AnalyzedExprs); }
515 void ReplaceSubExpr(TSRef<CExpressionBase> SubExpr, int32_t Index)
516 {
517 ULANG_ASSERTF(Index >= 0 && Index < _SubExprs.Num(), "Replacing invalid subexpression index");
518 _SubExprs[Index] = Move(SubExpr);
519 }
520
521 UE_API virtual bool CanFail(const CAstPackage* Package) const override;
522 UE_API virtual const CExpressionBase* FindFirstAsyncSubExpr(const CSemanticProgram& Program) const override;
523 virtual void VisitChildren(SAstVisitor& Visitor) const override { Visitor.VisitArray("SubExprs", _SubExprs); }
524
525protected:
526
527 // Internal data
528
529 TArray<TSRef<CExpressionBase>> _SubExprs;
530};

536class AUTORTFM_DISABLE CExprBinaryOp : public CExpressionBase
537{
538private:
539 // Operands
540 TSPtr<CExpressionBase> _Lhs;
541 TSPtr<CExpressionBase> _Rhs;
542
543public:
544
545 const TSPtr<CExpressionBase>& Lhs() const { return _Lhs; }
546 const TSPtr<CExpressionBase>& Rhs() const { return _Rhs; }
547 TSPtr<CExpressionBase>&& TakeRhs() { return Move(_Rhs); }
548 void SetLhs(TSPtr<CExpressionBase>&& NewLhs) { _Lhs = Move(NewLhs); }
549 void SetRhs(TSPtr<CExpressionBase>&& NewRhs) { _Rhs = Move(NewRhs); }
550
551 CExprBinaryOp(TSPtr<CExpressionBase>&& Lhs, TSPtr<CExpressionBase>&& Rhs) : _Lhs(Move(Lhs)), _Rhs(Move(Rhs)) {}
552
553 virtual const CExpressionBase* FindFirstAsyncSubExpr(const CSemanticProgram& Program) const override { const CExpressionBase* AsyncExpr = _Lhs->FindFirstAsyncSubExpr(Program); return AsyncExpr ? AsyncExpr : _Rhs->FindFirstAsyncSubExpr(Program); }
554 virtual void VisitChildren(SAstVisitor& Visitor) const override { Visitor.Visit("Lhs", _Lhs); Visitor.Visit("Rhs", _Rhs); }

657class AUTORTFM_DISABLE CExprChar : public CExpressionBase
658{
659public:
660 enum class EType
661 {
662 UTF8CodeUnit,
663 UnicodeCodePoint
664 };
665
666 uint32_t _CodePoint;
667 EType _Type;
668
669 explicit CExprChar(uint32_t CodePoint, EType Type)
670 : _CodePoint(CodePoint)
671 , _Type(Type)
672 {
673 if(_Type == EType::UTF8CodeUnit)
674 {
675 ULANG_ASSERTF(_CodePoint <= 0xFF, "utf8 code units must be <= 0xFF");
676 }
677 }
678
679 CUTF8String AsString() const
680 {
681 switch (_Type)
682 {
683 case CExprChar::EType::UTF8CodeUnit:
684 {
685 const UTF8Char CodeUnit = {static_cast<UTF8Char>(_CodePoint)};
686 return CUTF8StringView(&CodeUnit, &CodeUnit + 1);
687 }
688 case CExprChar::EType::UnicodeCodePoint:
689 {
690 SUTF8CodePoint Utf8 = CUnicode::EncodeUTF8(_CodePoint);
691 return CUTF8StringView(Utf8.Units, Utf8.Units + Utf8.NumUnits);
692 }
693 default:
694 ULANG_UNREACHABLE();
695 }
696 }
697
698 virtual EAstNodeType GetNodeType() const override { return EAstNodeType::Literal_Char; }
699 virtual CUTF8String GetErrorDesc() const override { return "char literal"; }
700
701 virtual void VisitImmediates(SAstVisitor& Visitor) const override { CExpressionBase::VisitImmediates(Visitor); Visitor.VisitImmediate("CodePoint", static_cast<int64_t>(_CodePoint)); }
702};

1273
1274enum class EMacroClauseTag : uint32_t
1275{
1276 None = 0x1 << 0,
1277 Of = 0x1 << 1,
1278 Do = 0x1 << 2
1279};
1280
1281constexpr EMacroClauseTag operator| (EMacroClauseTag A, EMacroClauseTag B) { return static_cast<EMacroClauseTag>(static_cast<uint32_t>(A) | static_cast<uint32_t>(B)); }
1282constexpr bool HasAnyTags(EMacroClauseTag A, EMacroClauseTag B) { return 0 != (static_cast<uint32_t>(A) & static_cast<uint32_t>(B)); }
1283constexpr bool HasAllTags(EMacroClauseTag A, EMacroClauseTag RequiredTags)
1284{
1285 return RequiredTags == static_cast<EMacroClauseTag>(static_cast<uint32_t>(A) & static_cast<uint32_t>(RequiredTags));
1286}
1287inline const char* MacroClauseTagAsCString(EMacroClauseTag Tag)
1288{
1289 switch(Tag)
1290 {
1291 case EMacroClauseTag::None: return "None";
1292 case EMacroClauseTag::Of: return "Of";
1293 case EMacroClauseTag::Do: return "Do";
1294 default: ULANG_UNREACHABLE();
1295 };
1296}
1297inline const char* MacroClauseFormAsCString(Verse::Vst::Clause::EForm Form)
1298{
1299 switch(Form)
1300 {
1301 case Verse::Vst::Clause::EForm::Synthetic: return "Synthetic";
1302 case Verse::Vst::Clause::EForm::NoSemicolonOrNewline: return "NoSemicolonOrNewline";
1303 case Verse::Vst::Clause::EForm::HasSemicolonOrNewline: return "HasSemicolonOrNewline";
1304 case Verse::Vst::Clause::EForm::IsAppendAttributeHolder: return "IsAppendAttributeHolder";
1305 case Verse::Vst::Clause::EForm::IsPrependAttributeHolder: return "IsPrependAttributeHolder";
1306 default: ULANG_UNREACHABLE();
1307 };
1308}

1311class AUTORTFM_DISABLE CExprMacroCall : public CExpressionBase
1312{
1313
1314public:
1315
1317 class CClause
1318 {
1319 public:
1320 using EForm = Verse::Vst::Clause::EForm;
1321
1322 CClause(EMacroClauseTag Tag, EForm Form, TArray<TSRef<CExpressionBase>>&& Exprs)
1323 : _Tag(Tag)
1324 , _Form(Form)
1325 , _Exprs(Move(Exprs))
1326 {}
1327
1328 EMacroClauseTag Tag() const { return _Tag; }
1329 EForm Form() const { return _Form; }
1330 TArray<TSRef<CExpressionBase>> const & Exprs() const { return _Exprs; }
1331 TArray<TSRef<CExpressionBase>> & Exprs() { return _Exprs; }
1332
1333
1334 private:
1335 EMacroClauseTag _Tag;
1336 Verse::Vst::Clause::EForm _Form;
1337 TArray<TSRef<CExpressionBase>> _Exprs;
1338 };
1339
1340
1341public:
1342 CExprMacroCall( TSRef<CExpressionBase>&& Name, int32_t NumClauses = 0 )
1343 : _Name(Move(Name))
1344 , _Clauses()
1345 {
1346 if (NumClauses != 0)
1347 {
1348 _Clauses.Reserve(NumClauses);
1349 }
1350 }
1351
1352 void AppendClause(CClause&& Clause)
1353 {
1354 _Clauses.Add(Move(Clause));
1355 }
1356
1357 TSRef<CExpressionBase> const & Name() const { return _Name; }
1358 TSRef<CExpressionBase> & Name() { return _Name; }
1359 void SetName(TSRef<CExpressionBase>&& NewName) { _Name = Move(NewName); }
1360
1361 TSRef<CExpressionBase>&& TakeName() { return Move(_Name); }
1362
1363 TArray<CClause> const& Clauses() const { return _Clauses; }
1364 TArray<CClause> & Clauses() { return _Clauses; }
1365
1366 TArray<CClause>&& TakeClauses() { return Move(_Clauses); }
1367
1368 virtual bool CanBePathSegment(const TMacroSymbols& MacroSymbols) const override {
1369 CSymbol Symbol;
1370 if (_Name->GetNodeType() == EAstNodeType::Identifier_BuiltInMacro) {
1371 Symbol = static_cast<CExprIdentifierBuiltInMacro*>(_Name.Get())->_Symbol;
1372 }
1373 else if (_Name->GetNodeType() == EAstNodeType::Identifier_Unresolved)
1374 {
1375 Symbol = static_cast<CExprIdentifierUnresolved*>(_Name.Get())->_Symbol;
1376 }
1377 if (!Symbol.IsNull())
1378 {
1379 for (CSymbol MacroSymbol : MacroSymbols)
1380 {
1381 if (MacroSymbol == Symbol)
1382 {
1383 return true;
1384 }
1385 }
1386 }
1387 return false;
1388 }
1389private:
1390 // Inherited via CExpressionBase
1391 virtual EAstNodeType GetNodeType() const override { return EAstNodeType::MacroCall; }
1392 virtual CUTF8String GetErrorDesc() const override { return "macro invocation"; }
1393
1394 virtual void VisitChildren(SAstVisitor& Visitor) const override
1395 {
1396 Visitor.Visit("Name", _Name);
1397 Visitor.BeginArray("Clauses", _Clauses.Num());
1398 for (const CClause& Clause : _Clauses)
1399 {
1400 Visitor.VisitArray("Exprs", Clause.Exprs());
1401 }
1402 Visitor.EndArray();
1403 }
1404 virtual void VisitImmediates(SAstVisitor& Visitor) const override
1405 {
1406 CExpressionBase::VisitImmediates(Visitor);
1407 Visitor.BeginArray("Clauses", _Clauses.Num());
1408 for (const CClause& Clause : _Clauses)
1409 {
1410 Visitor.VisitImmediate("Tag", MacroClauseTagAsCString(Clause.Tag()));
1411 Visitor.VisitImmediate("Form", MacroClauseFormAsCString(Clause.Form()));
1412 }
1413 Visitor.EndArray();
1414 }
1415
1416private:
1417 TSRef<CExpressionBase> _Name;
1418 TArray<CClause> _Clauses;
1419};

1425class AUTORTFM_DISABLE CExprInvocation : public CExpressionBase
1426{
1427public:
1428
1429 enum class EBracketingStyle
1430 {
1431 Undefined,
1432 Parentheses,
1433 SquareBrackets,
1434 };
1435 EBracketingStyle _CallsiteBracketStyle = EBracketingStyle::Undefined;
1436
1437 template<typename TCallee, typename TArgument>
1438 CExprInvocation(EBracketingStyle CallsiteBracketStyle, TCallee&& Callee, TArgument&& Argument)
1439 : _CallsiteBracketStyle(CallsiteBracketStyle)
1440 , _Callee(ForwardArg<TCallee>(Callee))
1441 , _Argument(ForwardArg<TArgument>(Argument))
1442 {}
1443
1444 template<typename TCallee, typename TArgument>
1445 CExprInvocation(EBracketingStyle CallsiteBracketStyle,
1446 TCallee&& Callee,
1447 TArgument&& Argument,
1448 const CFunctionType* ResolvedCalleeType,
1449 const CTypeBase* ResultType)
1450 : CExprInvocation(CallsiteBracketStyle, ForwardArg<TCallee>(Callee), ForwardArg<TArgument>(Argument))
1451 {
1452 SetResolvedCalleeType(ResolvedCalleeType);
1453 SetResultType(ResultType);
1454 }
1455
1456 explicit CExprInvocation(TSRef<CExpressionBase>&& Argument)
1457 : _Argument(Move(Argument))
1458 {}
1459
1460 CExprInvocation(CExprInvocation&& Rhs)
1461 : _Callee(Move(Rhs._Callee))
1462 , _Argument(Move(Rhs._Argument))
1463 , _ResolvedCalleeType(Rhs._ResolvedCalleeType)
1464 {}
1465
1466 const TSPtr<CExpressionBase>& GetCallee() const { return _Callee; }
1467 TSPtr<CExpressionBase>&& TakeCallee() { return Move(_Callee); }
1468 void SetCallee(TSPtr<CExpressionBase>&& Callee) { _Callee = Move(Callee); }
1469
1470 const TSRef<CExpressionBase>& GetArgument() const { return _Argument; }
1471 TSRef<CExpressionBase>&& TakeArgument() { return Move(_Argument); }
1472 void SetArgument(TSRef<CExpressionBase>&& Arguments) { _Argument = Move(Arguments); }
1473
1474 UE_API const CFunctionType* GetResolvedCalleeType() const;
1475 void SetResolvedCalleeType(const CFunctionType* ResolvedCalleeType) { _ResolvedCalleeType = ResolvedCalleeType; }
1476
1478 UE_API virtual const CExpressionBase* FindFirstAsyncSubExpr(const CSemanticProgram& Program) const override;
1479
1480 UE_API virtual bool CanFail(const CAstPackage* Package) const override;
1481 virtual EAstNodeType GetNodeType() const override { return EAstNodeType::Invoke_Invocation; }
1482 virtual CUTF8String GetErrorDesc() const override { return "invocation"; }
1483 virtual void VisitChildren(SAstVisitor& Visitor) const override { Visitor.Visit("Callee", _Callee); Visitor.Visit("Argument", _Argument); }
1484 virtual void VisitImmediates(SAstVisitor& Visitor) const override
1485 {
1486 CExpressionBase::VisitImmediates(Visitor);
1487 const char* BracketStyleString;
1488 switch(_CallsiteBracketStyle)
1489 {
1490 case EBracketingStyle::Undefined: BracketStyleString = "Undefined"; break;
1491 case EBracketingStyle::Parentheses: BracketStyleString = "Parentheses"; break;
1492 case EBracketingStyle::SquareBrackets: BracketStyleString = "SquareBrackets"; break;
1493 default: ULANG_UNREACHABLE();
1494 };
1495 Visitor.VisitImmediate("CallsiteBracketStyle", BracketStyleString);
1496
1497 if (_ResolvedCalleeType)
1498 {
1499 Visitor.VisitImmediate("ResolvedCalleeType", _ResolvedCalleeType);
1500 }
1501 }
1502
1503 bool bResultUsed { true }; // We conservatively say true. But some optimizations rely on us proving this is false.
1504private:
1505 // Callee subexpression - The function to call.
1506 TSPtr<CExpressionBase> _Callee;
1507
1508 // Argument - possibly a tuple of expressions, included named expressions
1509 TSRef<CExpressionBase> _Argument;
1510
1511 // More often than not, the function type could be inferred from _Callee, but in the case of generics,
1512 // you want to store the function type of the resolved generic.
1513 const CFunctionType* _ResolvedCalleeType{nullptr};
1514};

1527class AUTORTFM_DISABLE CExprTupleElement : public CExpressionBase
1528{
1529public:
1530
1531 // Expression that results in tuple to access element from
1532 TSPtr<CExpressionBase> _TupleExpr;
1533
1534 // Index resolved from `_ElemIdxExpr`
1535 Integer _ElemIdx;
1536
1537 // Expression used to determine index - currently must be an integer literal CExprNumber.
1538 // `_ElemIdx` is resolved form.
1539 TSPtr<CExpressionBase> _ElemIdxExpr;
1540
1541 CExprTupleElement(CExprInvocation& Invocation) : _TupleExpr(Invocation.TakeCallee()), _ElemIdx(-1) { Invocation.GetMappedVstNode()->AddMapping(this); }
1542 CExprTupleElement(TSPtr<CExpressionBase> TupleExpr, Integer ElemIdx, const Verse::Vst::Node* MappedVstNode) : _TupleExpr(TupleExpr), _ElemIdx(ElemIdx) { _MappedVstNode = MappedVstNode; }
1543
1544 UE_API virtual bool CanFail(const CAstPackage* Package) const override;
1545 virtual void VisitChildren(SAstVisitor& Visitor) const override { Visitor.Visit("TupleExpr", _TupleExpr); Visitor.Visit("ElemIdxExpr", _ElemIdxExpr); }
1546 virtual void VisitImmediates(SAstVisitor& Visitor) const override { CExpressionBase::VisitImmediates(Visitor); Visitor.VisitImmediate("ElemIdx", _ElemIdx); }
1547 virtual EAstNodeType GetNodeType() const override { return EAstNodeType::Invoke_TupleElement; }
1548 virtual CUTF8String GetErrorDesc() const override { return "tuple element access"; }
1549
1550 virtual const CExpressionBase* FindFirstAsyncSubExpr(const CSemanticProgram& Program) const override
1551 {
1552 if (const CExpressionBase* AsyncExpr = _TupleExpr->FindFirstAsyncSubExpr(Program))
1553 {
1554 return AsyncExpr;
1555 }
1556 if (_ElemIdxExpr)
1557 {
1558 return _ElemIdxExpr->FindFirstAsyncSubExpr(Program);
1559 }
1560 return nullptr;
1561 }
1562};

2445class AUTORTFM_DISABLE CExprArchetypeInstantiation : public CExpressionBase
2446{
2447public:
2448 UE_API CExprArchetypeInstantiation(TSRef<CExpressionBase>&& ClassAst, CExprMacroCall::CClause&& BodyAst, const CTypeBase* ResultType, const bool bIsDynamicConcreteType);
2449
2450 UE_API const CNominalType* GetClassOrInterface(const CSemanticProgram& Program) const;
2451
2452 const TSRefArray<CExpressionBase>& Arguments() const { return _Arguments; }
2453
2454 int32_t AppendArgument(TSRef<CExpressionBase>&& Argument)
2455 {
2456 return _Arguments.Add(Move(Argument));
2457 }
2458
2459 virtual bool CanFail(const CAstPackage* Package) const override
2460 {
2461 for (const auto& Argument : _Arguments)
2462 {
2463 if (Argument->CanFail(Package))
2464 {
2465 return true;
2466 }
2467 }
2468 return false;
2469 }
2470
2471 virtual EAstNodeType GetNodeType() const override { return EAstNodeType::Invoke_ArchetypeInstantiation; }
2472
2473 virtual CUTF8String GetErrorDesc() const override { return "archetype constructor"; }
2474
2475 virtual void VisitChildren(SAstVisitor& Visitor) const override
2476 {
2477 Visitor.Visit("ClassAst", _ClassAst);
2478 Visitor.VisitArray("BodyAstExprs", _BodyAst.Exprs());
2479 Visitor.BeginArray("Arguments", _Arguments.Num());
2480 for(const TSRef<CExpressionBase>& Argument : _Arguments)
2481 {
2482 Visitor.VisitElement(Argument);
2483 }
2484 Visitor.EndArray();
2485 }
2486
2487 virtual void VisitImmediates(SAstVisitor& Visitor) const override
2488 {
2489 CExpressionBase::VisitImmediates(Visitor);
2490 Visitor.VisitImmediate("BodyAstTag", MacroClauseTagAsCString(_BodyAst.Tag()));
2491 Visitor.VisitImmediate("BodyAstForm", MacroClauseFormAsCString(_BodyAst.Form()));
2492 }
2493
2494 TSRef<CExpressionBase> _ClassAst;
2495 CExprMacroCall::CClause _BodyAst;
2496 const bool _bIsDynamicConcreteType;
2497
2498private:
2499 TSRefArray<CExpressionBase> _Arguments;
2500};

2649class AUTORTFM_DISABLE CExprBinaryAwaitOp : public CExpressionBase
2650{
2651public:
2652 CExprBinaryAwaitOp(TSRefArray<CExpressionBase> DomainExprs, TSRefArray<CExpressionBase> RangeExprs)
2653 : _DomainExprs(Move(DomainExprs))
2654 , _RangeExprs(Move(RangeExprs))
2655 {
2656 }
2657
2658 CExprBinaryAwaitOp(int32_t NumReservedDomainExprs, int32_t NumReservedRangeExprs)
2659 {
2660 _DomainExprs.Reserve(NumReservedDomainExprs);
2661 _RangeExprs.Reserve(NumReservedRangeExprs);
2662 }
2663
2664 virtual bool MayHaveAttributes() const override { return false; }
2665
2666 virtual bool CanFail(const CAstPackage* Package) const override { return false; }
2667
2668 virtual const CExpressionBase* FindFirstAsyncSubExpr(const CSemanticProgram& Program) const override
2669 {
2670 for (const auto& RangeExpr : _RangeExprs)
2671 {
2672 if (const CExpressionBase* FirstAyncSubExpr = RangeExpr->FindFirstAsyncSubExpr(Program))
2673 {
2674 return FirstAyncSubExpr;
2675 }
2676 }
2677 return nullptr;
2678 }
2679
2680 const TSRefArray<CExpressionBase>& GetDomainExprs() const
2681 {
2682 return _DomainExprs;
2683 }
2684
2685 const TSRefArray<CExpressionBase>& GetRangeExprs() const
2686 {
2687 return _RangeExprs;
2688 }
2689
2690 void AppendDomainExpr(TSRef<CExpressionBase> Expr)
2691 {
2692 _DomainExprs.Add(Move(Expr));
2693 }
2694
2695 void AppendRangeExpr(TSRef<CExpressionBase> Expr)
2696 {
2697 _RangeExprs.Add(Move(Expr));
2698 }
2699
2700 CCaptureControlScope* _DomainScope{nullptr};
2701
2702private:
2703 TSRefArray<CExpressionBase> _DomainExprs;
2704 TSRefArray<CExpressionBase> _RangeExprs;
2705};

3608template <typename TIn, typename TOut>
3609struct TAsNullableTraitsOf;
3610
3611template <typename TOut>
3612struct TAsNullableTraitsOf<TSPtr<CExpressionBase>, TOut>
3613{
3614 using TResult = TSPtr<TOut>;
3615 static TResult Cast(TSPtr<CExpressionBase> X) { return X.As<TOut>(); }
3616};
3617
3618template <typename TOut>
3619struct TAsNullableTraitsOf<TSRef<CExpressionBase>, TOut>
3620{
3621 using TResult = TSPtr<TOut>;
3622 static TResult Cast(TSRef<CExpressionBase> X) { return X.As<TOut>(); }
3623};
3624
3625template <typename TOut>
3626struct TAsNullableTraitsOf<CExpressionBase*, TOut>
3627{
3628 using TResult = TOut*;
3629 static TResult Cast(CExpressionBase* X) { return static_cast<TOut*>(X); }
3630};
3631
3632template <typename TOut>
3633struct TAsNullableTraitsOf<const CExpressionBase*, TOut>
3634{
3635 using TResult = const TOut*;
3636 static TResult Cast(const CExpressionBase* X) { return static_cast<const TOut*>(X); }
3637};
3638
3639
3640template <typename TOut,
3641 typename TIn,
3642 typename Traits = TAsNullableTraitsOf<TIn, TOut>>
3643typename Traits::TResult AsNullable(TIn Expr)
3644{
3645#define VISIT_AST_NODE_TYPE(Name, Class) \
3646 if constexpr (std::is_same_v<TOut, Class>) \
3647 { \
3648 if (Expr && Expr->GetNodeType() == EAstNodeType::Name) \
3649 { \
3650 return Traits::Cast(Expr); \
3651 } \
3652 }
3653 VERSE_VISIT_AST_NODE_TYPES(VISIT_AST_NODE_TYPE)
3654#undef VISIT_AST_NODE_TYPE
3655 return nullptr;
3656}
3657
3658inline const char* AsStringLiteral(EAstNodeType Node)
3659{
3660#define VISIT_AST_NODE_TYPE(Name, Class) if (Node == EAstNodeType::Name) { return #Name; }
3661 VERSE_VISIT_AST_NODE_TYPES(VISIT_AST_NODE_TYPE)
3662#undef VISIT_AST_NODE_TYPE
3663 ULANG_UNREACHABLE();
3664}
